DriverNotes.Text: The camera vehicle was travelling faster than it did for most of the video.
The camera vehicle was keeping pace with the traffic around it.
No braking was seen before the impact; there was little time to react.
The camera doesn't show the inside of the cab, so phone use or other distraction can only be judged from how the vehicle moved.

Narrative: At 0:08.0 the video shows a collision with a pedestrian, directly ahead in the camera vehicle's lane, at the front of the camera vehicle. Involved: the camera vehicle, V1 (white car), P1 (pedestrian). 19 other road users were in view but not involved. Most of the fault lies with the camera vehicle (100%). Nothing in the camera vehicle's own driving stood out as a cause.
